name: Fonts
content:
### Allowed hostnames
For security reasons, only fonts with certain hostnames can be accessed in Web Lab. Currently, the hostname must end in one of the following:

**Google Fonts**
- [fonts.googleapis.com](https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/getting_started) - API for google fonts
- [fonts.gstatic.com](https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/developer_api) -high-speed domain used by Google to serve font files
